description: A React component implementing a virtualized post list with scrolling, lazy loading, and UI controls for a chat application (Mattermost). It manages rendering posts, handling scroll events, and displaying toasts and timestamps.

classes.name: PostList
classes.description: React component managing a virtualized list of posts with scrolling, lazy loading, and UI controls for a chat channel.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for window resize and scroll-to-bottom events.

methods.name: getSnapshotBeforeUpdate
methods.description: Captures scroll position before DOM updates to adjust scroll after new posts are added.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles post-update logic, including scrolling to focused posts and adjusting scroll position.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners when component unmounts.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Derives new state based on incoming props, managing post list IDs and UI styles.

methods.name: handleWindowResize
methods.description: Updates search hint threshold on window resize.

methods.name: togglePostMenu
methods.description: Opens or closes the post menu, adjusting style for mobile view.

methods.name: onNewMessageLineReached
methods.description: Sets state when a new message line is reached.

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders individual post rows with styling and event handling.

methods.name: scrollToFailed
methods.description: Handles scroll failure by updating unread timestamp.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events, triggering load of older/newer posts, updating UI states, and managing toasts.

methods.name: getShowSearchHintThreshold
methods.description: Calculates threshold for showing search hints based on screen height.

methods.name: checkBottom
methods.description: Checks if list is scrolled to bottom.

methods.name: getOffsetFromBottom
methods.description: Calculates distance from bottom of list.

methods.name: isAtBottom
methods.description: Determines if list is scrolled to bottom within a buffer.

methods.name: updateAtBottom
methods.description: Updates state when list reaches or leaves bottom, updating last viewed timestamp.

methods.name: updateLastViewedBottomAt
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of last viewed bottom position.

methods.name: handleScrollStop
methods.description: Handles logic when scrolling stops.

methods.name: handleSearchHintDismiss
methods.description: Dismisses search hint UI.

methods.name: handleScrollToBottomToastDismiss
methods.description: Dismisses scroll-to-bottom toast.

methods.name: hideScrollToBottomToast
methods.description: Hides scroll-to-bottom toast.

methods.name: updateScrollToBottomToastVisibility
methods.description: Manages visibility of scroll-to-bottom toast based on scroll position.

methods.name: updateFloatingTimestamp
methods.description: Updates timestamp display based on visible list item, for mobile view.

methods.name: onItemsRendered
methods.description: Updates timestamp and detects reaching new message line when items are rendered.

methods.name: initScrollToIndex
methods.description: Determines initial scroll position based on focus or unread status.

methods.name: scrollToLatestMessages
methods.description: Scrolls to latest messages or updates unread timestamp.

methods.name: scrollToUnreadMessages
methods.description: Scrolls to unread messages.

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls to bottom of list.

methods.name: scrollToNewMessage
methods.description: Scrolls to new message indicator.

methods.name: updateNewMessagesAtInChannel
methods.description: Updates new message timestamp in channel.

methods.name: renderToasts
methods.description: Renders toast notifications for scroll and search hints.
